name: Practice Growth Audit & Roadmap
short: I research how clients find therapists in your market, map your acquisition channels and deliver a prioritized, branded strategy deck.
intro: The audit is where every engagement starts. I look at your market the way a prospective client does, then look at your practice the way a referral source would.
does: Research how clients search for therapists in your area and specialty
Map where your current clients come from and which channels are missing
Review your website, profiles and listings against what's working locally
Deliver a branded strategy deck with priorities ranked by effort and impact
get: A roadmap you can act on with me or on your own, and a walkthrough call to go over it.

name: Referral Partner Development
short: I build prospect lists of local PCPs and providers, run a structured outreach playbook and set a cadence that keeps those relationships active.
intro: Physicians, psychiatrists, school counselors and other therapists are often the most reliable source of good-fit clients. Most practices just don't have a system for reaching them.
does: Build prospect lists of local PCPs, pediatricians, OB-GYNs, psychiatrists and other providers
Run a structured outreach playbook, from first contact to a warm introduction
Create referral materials, like a one-page practice sheet providers actually keep
Set up a follow-up cadence so relationships stay active
Build new employer and EAP partnerships, and reactivate ones that have gone quiet
get: A referral network with names, a rhythm for staying in touch and materials that make it easy to refer to you.
ethics: The ACA Code doesn't allow anything to be given or received in exchange for referrals. Every partnership we build runs on relationships and good follow-up, never on perks.

name: Directory & Listings Management
short: I audit your insurance directories, choose and optimize therapist directory profiles and claim your profiles on health platforms.
intro: Directories are often the first place a prospective client sees you, and insurance directories are notoriously out of date.
does: Audit your listings in insurance company directories and flag what's wrong
Choose the therapist directories worth your time, like Psychology Today, Zencare and Inclusive Therapists
Rewrite and optimize your profiles so they sound like you and match what clients search for
Claim and complete your profiles on health platforms like Healthgrades and Zocdoc
get: Accurate, consistent listings everywhere you appear, and profiles that bring in the clients you want to see.

name: Search Visibility: SEO + AI Search
short: A site audit, local SEO and service-by-location pages, plus visibility in AI answers from ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity and Google.
intro: More clients now ask an AI tool for a recommendation before they ever open a directory. Being findable means showing up in both places.
does: Audit your website for search and usability issues
Set up local SEO: your Google Business Profile, consistent name, address and phone listings, and schema
Build service and location pages, like “anxiety therapy in Media, PA”
Improve how your practice shows up in AI answers from ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews
get: A site search engines and AI tools can understand, and pages that match what people in your area are searching for.
ethics: Google reviews are a gray area for therapists. The ACA Code doesn't allow soliciting testimonials from current or former clients, so we build visibility without asking clients for reviews.

name: Paid Advertising
short: I choose the right mix of Google, Meta and LinkedIn, allocate small budgets starting around $50 a month and write compliant ad copy.
intro: Paid ads can work for therapists at a small scale, as long as they're set up carefully and follow the platforms' health rules.
does: Choose the right mix of Google, Meta and LinkedIn for your practice and goals
Allocate small budgets, starting around $50 a month
Write ad copy that sounds like you and speaks to what clients are feeling
Handle healthcare ad-policy compliance on each platform
get: Campaigns sized to your budget, with clear reporting on what they're doing.
ethics: Google and Meta restrict targeting by health conditions and how health services can be described. Your campaigns are built to stay inside those rules.

name: Social Media & Content Strategy
short: A social audit with real numbers, content pillars, brand voice and bio rewrites, post concepts and calls to action that lead to bookings.
intro: Social media doesn't have to mean dancing on camera. It can be a quiet, steady way for the right people to get a sense of who you are.
does: Audit your current social presence with real numbers
Define content pillars that fit your specialty and your comfort level
Rewrite your bios and set your brand voice
Develop post concepts and calls to action that lead to bookings
get: A sustainable plan for what to post, where and why, in a voice that's recognizably yours.
ethics: Your content speaks to common experiences without drawing on any client's story, and we plan for how you'll handle comments and messages from people who may be in distress.
